title: Design System: Stowaway public website (Luggage Tag)

extensions.scope: Public website composition (src/features/website, src/features/legal) plus the app theme that shares its palette, fonts and printed details (src/styles/app-theme.css, journal.css, travel-notebook.css, tokens.css, themes.css). The app keeps its task-focused layouts; it does not use the display scale or decorative route codes.
extensions.source: src/features/website/tag.css (tokens on .tag-world; dark under :root[data-theme='stowaway-dark'] .tag-world); app roles in src/styles/tokens.css and src/styles/themes.css (--stowaway-*)

display.purpose: The hero route codes, container-sized up to 10.25rem, on one line. Public site only; readable place names sit nearby.

code.purpose: Saved-place mini tags and vote option codes (2.25rem). Always aria-hidden beside readable text.

code-day.purpose: The route codes on a sample day card (CDG → PAR), 2.25-3.25rem at line-height .9.

code-stub.purpose: The offline keep stub's route, 2.25-3rem; prints in reverse with the stub.

code-strip.purpose: Route codes on the desktop routing rail (1.875rem). Below 1100px only the picked vote code shows, at 1.0625rem.

headline.purpose: The landing h1 only, Barlow 700, sentence case.

headline-page.purpose: Secondary page h1s in the Tag Head.

section-secondary.purpose: Section h2s on secondary pages (How it works, Pricing, For organizers), one step under the landing's stop titles.

price.purpose: Plan prices on Pricing, Barlow 600 with tabular figures; money is never set in route lettering.

title.purpose: Landing stop and section h2s, Barlow 600 sentence case, max 24ch.

question.purpose: The vote question and FAQ questions.

subtitle.purpose: Card and block titles inside a stop or secondary section.

body.purpose: Sentences; prose to 65ch. The app uses 1rem.

fine.purpose: Example disclosures and secondary detail under demonstrations.

control.purpose: Buttons, tear-stub labels, nav links, switches and chips: Barlow 600 sentence case, normal tracking.

label.purpose: Barlow Condensed uppercase field print paired with a value: dt, strip labels, the hero print row, the app's CONFIRMATION field. Never a lone section label.

caption.purpose: The 13px floor: secondary information, the app's trip name under a page title, sync strip text, vote tick counts.

row-title.purpose: Titles of tappable rows in the app.

app-entry-title.purpose: The title of a single record screen (a plan item).

card-title.purpose: Card headings in the app and on the site.

textures.name: halftone
textures.value: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tag-ink) 16%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.4px) 0 0 / 5px 5px
textures.purpose: Tentative plan items on the site (.tag-item.is-tentative) and tentative or idea agenda rows in the app (.agenda-stop[data-status]). Dark mode raises the dot to 22% ink.

textures.name: perforation
textures.value: 28px band; 2px dashed rule line; 11px radial-gradient notches of ground at both edges (ringed in rule inside the sheet)
textures.purpose: The only divider between stops and sections.

textures.name: tear-hole
textures.purpose: The punched half-hole on the tear side of tear stubs.

shadows.name: eyelet-ring
shadows.purpose: The reinforced hole at the top of the tag sheet.

shadows.name: mini-tag-hole
shadows.purpose: The string hole on saved-place mini tags.

shadows.name: winner-ring
shadows.purpose: The vote option the group picked.

shadows.name: current-stop-bar
shadows.purpose: The lit stop on the phone route bar.

shadows.name: winner-highlighter
shadows.purpose: Under the winner's name in the vote result.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid coral; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px ink
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control. The ink ring carries the contrast that coral alone (2.4:1 on light stock) cannot; fields drop the ring and outline their own ink edge.

motion.name: ease-tag
motion.purpose: The world's easing for print-in, stamps and state transitions; also --stowaway-feedback-ease in the app.

motion.name: hero-print-head
motion.value: @keyframes tag-head-reveal (clip-path inset top to bottom) + tag-head (3px ink head with a 4px half-tone developing band, masked over 8rem); 1000ms, no delay, cubic-bezier(.42, .06, .3, 1)
motion.purpose: First load only (.tag-hero.is-printing): the hero face prints top to bottom so the headline and both stubs are printed within the first half-second on a phone. Later visits in the session show it printed.

motion.name: hero-travelers
motion.purpose: Traveler names print one at a time behind the head.

motion.name: hero-coral-stamp
motion.value: @keyframes tag-coral-stamp { from { transparent, ink border, scale(1) } 32% { coral fill, scale(1.045) } to { scale(1) } }; 520ms at 1040ms (820ms below 960px)
motion.purpose: Coral lands last, stamped onto Create a trip.

motion.name: print-in
motion.value: @keyframes tag-print-in { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); opacity: .2 } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 1 } }; 300ms to 560ms
motion.purpose: Left-to-right reveal like a thermal head: stop titles once as they scroll in (560ms), mini tags (420ms), the picked plan row (480ms), your vote tick (300ms).

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: @keyframes tag-stamp { 0% { rotate(-14deg) scale(1.6); opacity 0 } 60% { rotate(-3deg) scale(.94) } 100% { rotate(-5deg) scale(1) } }; 420ms
motion.purpose: The PRIORITY stamp on the winning option and the plan slot it fills.

motion.name: strip-stamp
motion.value: @keyframes tag-strip-stamp { 0% { scale(1.6) rotate(-8deg); opacity 0 } 60% { scale(.94); opacity 1 } 100% { none } }; 420ms
motion.purpose: The winning code landing on the routing strip's vote stop (keyed so it replays only on the change from ghost to picked).

motion.name: winner-ring
motion.purpose: The winner ring arriving on a vote option.

motion.name: reverse-print
motion.purpose: The offline stub reversing when airplane mode toggles.

motion.name: app-durations
motion.value: feedback 120ms, change 180ms, enter 240ms, exit 140ms, fade 160ms, morph 340ms
motion.purpose: App motion roles in src/styles/tokens.css, mirrored in src/ui/motion.ts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shows every state already printed, on the site and in the app.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: hide the header's Open app box, smaller wordmark.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: compact tear stubs and traveler list; in the app, the sync strip prints across the header and the header keeps two tools.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Three-across mini tags, four-across name buttons and footer links.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column hero, tag head, stops and FAQ; the coral stamp waits for the head (1040ms) from here.

breakpoints.name: app-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: The app's rounded sheet on ocean ink with the dashed workspace rail.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop nav and the left routing rail with every route code; below it the strip shows labels plus only the picked code.

components.name: Tear Stub (primary)
components.description: The landing page's Create a trip: a coral tear-off stub with a punched hole on its tear side; coral stamps onto it last in the hero print.
components.html: Create a tripFree for the whole group
components.css: .ds-tear { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: center; gap: .25rem; min-height: 88px; max-width: 18rem; padding: .875rem 1rem .875rem 1.75rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 0; color: #17343f; text-decoration: none; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 8.5px, #000 9px); mask: radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 8.5px, #000 9px); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tear::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; left: .75rem; border-left: 2px dashed currentColor; opacity: .45; } .ds-tear-label { font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.8vw, 1.375rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-tear-print { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-tear-primary { background: #f0805f; border-color: #f0805f; color: #17343f; } .ds-tear-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: color-mix(in srgb, #f0805f 86%, #17343f); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #f0805f 86%, #17343f); } .ds-tear:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tear:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

components.name: Primary Button (subpages)
components.description: The coral primary action on secondary pages, sentence-case Barlow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: .75rem 1.375rem; border: 2px solid #f0805f; border-radius: 8px; background: #f0805f; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #f0805f 86%, #17343f); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #f0805f 86%, #17343f); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 48px; padding: .625rem 1rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #17343f; color: #f1f4f5; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

components.name: Choice Chips (vote scores)
components.description: Score buttons and the name picker; pressed fills ink, never coral.
components.css: .ds-score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .375rem; max-width: 26rem; } .ds-score button { min-height: 44px; padding: .375rem .25rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-score button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #17343f 8%, transparent); } .ds-score button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #17343f; color: #f1f4f5; } .ds-score button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

components.css: .ds-option { position: relative; display: grid; gap: .75rem; max-width: 24rem; padding: 1rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-option.is-winner { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f0805f; } .ds-option-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .875rem; } .ds-option-code { font-family: Antonio, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-option h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-option-head p { margin: 0; font-size: .875rem; color: #4a5e66; } .ds-option-head .ds-option-points { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: #17343f; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-option-points span { font-size: .875rem; color: #4a5e66; } .ds-ticks { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 12px; } .ds-ticks span { flex: 0 1 calc(var(--w) * 14px + 4px); min-width: 4px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: #17343f; } .ds-ticks span.is-yours { background: #f0805f; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; top: -.875rem; right: 1rem; display: inline-block; padding: .25rem .625rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 4px; background: #f0805f; color: #17343f; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-5deg); }

components.css: .ds-day { display: grid; gap: .5rem; max-width: 22rem; padding: 1.125rem 1.125rem 1rem; border: 2px solid #17343f; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-day-route { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .25rem; font-family: Antonio, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: .9; } .ds-day-route span { font-weight: 300; color: #4a5e66; } .ds-day h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-day ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 2px solid #17343f; } .ds-day li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; min-height: 52px; padding-block: .75rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed #9fb2b7; } .ds-day li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-time { font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-what { font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-what small { display: block; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-state { font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-day li.is-tentative { background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, #17343f 16%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.4px) 0 0 / 5px 5px; } .ds-day li.is-tentative .ds-state { color: #4a5e66; } .ds-day li.is-open { margin-top: .375rem; padding-inline: .5rem; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #f2c230; color: #17343f; }

components.name: Routing Strip
components.description: The rail of route codes pinning every stop. The vote stop is an empty dashed slot until the vote; then the winning code prints on coral with a 420ms strip stamp. Below 1100px only that picked code shows, beside the Vote label. The lit stop is ink.
components.html:
1. CDGTrip
  2. PARSave
  3. ···Vote
  4. MONVote
  5. VRSPlan
components.css: .ds-strip { width: 12rem; background: #f1f4f5; } .ds-strip ol { display: grid; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-left: 1px solid #17343f; } .ds-strip a { display: grid; gap: .125rem; min-height: 60px; padding: .5rem 0 .5rem 1rem; color: #4a5e66; text-decoration: none; } .ds-code { font-family: Antonio, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #17343f; justify-self: start; } .ds-lbl { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strip a[data-ghost] .ds-code { display: inline-block; width: 2.1em; height: .86em; overflow: hidden; border: 2px dashed #9fb2b7; border-radius: 2px; color: transparent; } .ds-strip a[data-picked] .ds-code { display: inline-block; width: fit-content; padding: .125rem .25rem; background: #f0805f; color: #17343f; animation: ds-strip-stamp 420ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-strip-stamp { 0% { transform: scale(1.6) rotate(-8deg); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: scale(.94); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-strip a[data-picked] .ds-code { animation: none; } } .ds-strip a[aria-current='step'] { color: #17343f; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17343f 9%, transparent); } .ds-strip a:hover .ds-lbl { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-strip a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

components.name: Tag Head Fields
components.description: The printed field list that opens every secondary page: condensed labels paired with Barlow values on dashed rules.
components.css: .ds-fields { display: grid; max-width: 28rem; margin: 0; border-top: 3px solid #17343f; color: #17343f; } .ds-fields > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 8rem) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; align-items: baseline; padding-block: .625rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed #9fb2b7; } .ds-fields dt { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5e66; } .ds-fields dd { margin: 0; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: App Header with Trip Context
components.description: The app's screen header: the title prints first and the trip's name prints under it in muted Barlow at the caption floor (.ui-header-context), never as a condensed label above.
components.css: .ds-app-header { padding: .75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed #9fb2b7; background: #f1f4f5; color: #17343f; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 24rem; } .ds-app-header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.05rem + .75vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-app-context { margin: .125rem 0 0; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #4a5e66; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: App Sync Strip (phones)
components.description: Below 640px, offline and sync trouble print in words across the header (.sync-strip): mist for offline, the danger tone for anything not synced. Silent while everything is up to date.
components.css: .ds-sync-wrap { display: grid; max-width: 24rem; } .ds-sync { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; border: 0; border-top: 1px dashed #9fb2b7; padding: .5rem 1rem; text-align: start; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .8125rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #17343f; background: #e8f0f1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sync strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-sync[data-tone='danger'] { background: #f9e6df; color: #9a2f22; } .ds-sync:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-sync:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0805f; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #17343f; }

narrative.overview:
Every public page is one long luggage tag hung on an ocean-ink ground. The header carries the eyelet the tag hangs from, the footer closes the sheet, and everything between is printed on cool thermal stock in ink: route codes at display scale, travelers in condensed print, the plan as a routing, tickets as tear-off stubs, barcodes as the closing mark. Sections are separated by perforated tear lines with notches cut from both edges. The page reads like a trip printing itself, line by line.

The density is a printed document's: hard 2px ink strokes, dashed rules, small condensed travel labels, and generous blocks of air between stops. Colour is almost entirely ink on stock. Coral is the one loud colour and belongs to the group's choice and the primary action; signal yellow marks what is still open. State is shown as print density (solid, half-toned, ghost), never as a new colour. Dark mode is the same tag printed in reverse.

Scope. The public website uses the luggage-tag composition. The working app shares its palette, fonts and printed details through src/styles/app-theme.css, while retaining its task-focused layouts: the trip name prints under each page title, phones print offline and sync trouble across the header in words, tentative plan rows print on the half-tone, real confirmation codes print as field print, and votes show as a tick bar. Shared typography roles live in src/styles/tokens.css and the component guidance in docs/UI_COMPONENTS.md.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet of tag stock on an ink ground, with an eyelet at the top and 22px sheet corners top and bottom.
Perforated tear lines are the section dividers; dashed rules divide inside a section.
Antonio route codes (CDG, PAR, VRS, MON) are the display voice; Barlow carries headings, body and controls; Barlow Condensed is reserved for small travel labels.
Coral appears only on the group's choice and the primary action.
Print density shows state: confirmed solid, tentative half-toned, empty as a dashed ghost tag or slot.
Motion prints in once and stamps; nothing loops.

rules.name: The Coral Ledger Rule
rules.body: Coral is spent only on the primary action, the PRIORITY stamp, the vote winner, your vote tick (on the site and in the app), the picked strip code, selection and focus. Links, hovers, the current nav item and the current strip stop are ink. If a new element wants coral, it has to be the group's choice or the one action that starts a trip.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Open Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow marks a slot or offer that is not settled yet. It never decorates, and it always carries ink text.

rules.name: The Code Is Print Rule
rules.body: Route codes decorate a fact stated in words. Hide decorative codes and barcodes from assistive technology and supply the readable meaning nearby. Real booking references and money are not route lettering; they print in Barlow.

rules.name: The Field, Not Kicker Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase print identifies a travel field or metadata, paired with its value (Travelers · 8, Confirmation · VX7-4QM2, Updated / October 30, 2026). Never use condensed capitals as the default for section headings, buttons or long text, and never alone above a heading.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reserve the largest type for the page's subject. Body, captions, controls and statuses have distinct roles; stronger weight is not the default everywhere. Use actual supplied weights, preserve user text scaling and let containers grow.

rules.name: The Print Density Rule
rules.body: State is shown by how heavily something is printed. Confirmed prints solid. Tentative prints on a 5px half-tone dot with lighter weight and faded state text, on the site and on the app's tentative and idea agenda rows. Empty is a ghost: dashed rule outline, no fill, faded print ("Your idea"), or the strip's empty dashed vote slot. Don't add a colour to show state.

rules.name: The Reverse Print Rule
rules.body: Reversal is the only inversion: dark mode prints the whole tag in reverse, and the offline stub prints in reverse (ink fill, stock text) when airplane mode is on.

dos: Do keep every public page inside the website frame so it hangs as one tag: eyelet header, stock sheet, perforated sections, footer edge.
Do separate stops and sections with the Perforation, and divide within a section with 1px or 2px dashed rule lines.
Do print state as density: solid for confirmed, the half-tone dot for tentative, a dashed ghost for empty.
Do put a readable name beside every route code and barcode, and hide the code itself from assistive tech.
Do introduce the homepage's demonstrations together as an example trip; keep individual example labels on standalone previews only.
Do use short feature names and action labels, and write factual status messages instead of encouragement or reassurance.
Do use the Tag Head with printed fields to open a secondary page.
Do keep targets at 44px or more and the coral-over-ink focus ring on everything interactive.
Do keep anything people read at 13px (0.8125rem) or larger; text-xs is remapped to it, and form fields stay at 16px.

Do carry the luggage-tag palette, local fonts, flat ink borders and dashed rules into the app, with coral primary actions and ink selected controls; keep semantic warning, danger, success and category colours.
Do pass place-category colours through categoryTone() when they colour an icon or text; dark mode lifts them toward ink.
Do keep overlays flat: no blurred shadows on dialogs, sheets, toasts or the add button; backdrops are the ground at 45%.
donts: Don't use coral outside the Coral Ledger: not for links, hovers, the current nav item, pressed chips or the lit strip stop.
Don't use signal yellow for anything that is settled.
Don't add blurred or offset drop shadows; depth is stock, stroke, holes and reverse print.
Don't put small uppercase print alone above a heading as a section label; field print always pairs a label with its value.
Don't number the stops; the routing strip identifies them by route code.
Don't retype, recolour or rotate the Stowaway wordmark or mark; use the drawn lockup from src/ui/Brand.tsx.

Don't use the public page's oversized display scale or decorative route codes for the app's everyday navigation; trip names, dates, real confirmation codes and saved states provide the character there.
